title: Webhook Signature
description: Verifies an HMAC-signed inbound webhook and rejects the request unless the signature matches. No property has a default: an API definition states the whole contract.

source.title: Signature source
source.description: Where the signature and the signed message come from. 'header': the signature is in a request header and the raw request body is signed (GitHub, Sentry, Meta/WhatsApp). 'mailgun-json': Mailgun event webhooks — timestamp + token are signed, all three values read from the JSON body's 'signature' object. 'mailgun-multipart': Mailgun routes — the same scheme, read from multipart/form-data fields.

header.title: Signature header
header.description: Request header carrying the signature, e.g. X-Hub-Signature-256. Required when source is 'header'; ignored otherwise.

prefix.title: Signature prefix
prefix.description: Literal text preceding the digest in the header value, e.g. 'sha256='. Use an empty string when the provider sends a bare digest. Required when source is 'header'; ignored otherwise.

encoding.title: Digest encoding
encoding.description: How the received digest is encoded. Hex is compared case-insensitively.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.description: The HMAC key. Supports Gravitee Expression Language, including deferred secret lookups such as {#secrets.get('...')}. A value that resolves to empty rejects every request with 401.
